_comment: R36.1 retrieval benchmark question set. Runnable entries (owner_run=false) run against the repo's sample/ + sample-ai/ corpora. Owner-run entries need private corpora (see docs/bench-chunking.md). Fields: id, question, corpus, target {file, section}, required_docs (coverage set), grep_baseline (manual, nullable), owner_run, notes.

questions.question: What are the steps of an outgoing instant payment?
questions.notes: Known answer: 6 steps in order — Initiation, Validation, Funds hold, Submission, Payment confirmation, Audit record. Spec holds the steps; d1 holds the outgoing-only scope decision.

questions.question: What is the rollback plan for the billing provider migration?
questions.notes: Known answer: feature flag flips any tenant back to legacy within 5 minutes (runbook step 6 'Rollback check'); d2 records the rollback constraint. Both docs must appear for full coverage.

questions.question: Who owns the billing provider migration and when is it due?
questions.notes: Known answer: Sarah owns it, due end of next week. d2 has owner+due; sprint12 action items repeat both. Section is null: answer is file-level metadata (Status line), any section of d2 counts.

questions.question: Why were incoming payments excluded from the Instant Payments MVP?
questions.notes: Known answer: reconciliation complexity — matching external bank statements, returned payments, payer bank records. d1 has the reasoning; sprint12 decision log records the same call (PRD v3 section 4.2).

questions.question: What are the serving tiers in router v2 and when is each used?
questions.notes: Known answer: small-local (short factual lookups, local-only default) vs frontier-api (multi-step reasoning, needs egress policy). Spec defines tiers; d1 records the approval + shadow-run evidence.

questions.question: What are the eval gate thresholds for launch?
questions.notes: Known answer: citation accuracy >= 0.92, unsupported-claim rate <= 0.03, refusal rate <= 0.02, p95 latency <= 2.5s on reasoning slice. d2 holds the numbers; the runbook holds the gate procedure.

questions.question: What caused the INC-114 incident and what changed afterwards?
questions.notes: Known answer: shadow build read tier from request body instead of the policy service; 214 requests leaked to frontier for 19 min. Fixes: server-side tier derivation, egress preflight, cloud-boundary alert. d1 cross-references the postmortem.

questions.question: Who owns the eval harness and the regression gates?
questions.notes: Known answer: Tomas (evals engineer). people.md ownership table; the runbook is owned by Tomas and names him for escalation. Tests retrieval of a table row + cross-doc ownership.

questions.question: Which Acme types and routes are configured in routing-config.yml?
questions.notes: OWNER-RUN against the private treasury Go monorepo. Known-answer notes from the task brief: routing-config.yml holds Acme types/routes. Owner: confirm the section breadcrumb and required docs on first run; this is a config-by-keys split case (R33.4).

questions.question: What reports exist and what are their filename templates and columns?
questions.notes: OWNER-RUN against the private treasury monorepo. Target file + required docs intentionally blank: the owner fills in the report spec doc(s) holding filename templates and column lists on first run. Breadth case: answer spans the report inventory plus each report's template/columns.

questions.question: What is the difference between Atlas and Beacon, and what does the Equities Launch Note say?
questions.notes: OWNER-RUN against the private Atlas-vs-Beacon / Equities-Launch-Note business docs. Target + required docs blank for the owner to fill (at least the Atlas-vs-Beacon doc and the Equities Launch Note doc). Classic breadth case: two independent docs must both surface.

questions.question: Which funding methods are supported and how is each one set up?
questions.notes: OWNER-RUN against the private business docs holding funding methods. Target + required docs blank for the owner to fill. Depth case if one doc, breadth case if methods span docs — owner decides on first run.

questions.question: What payment schemes are described and what are their key dates and terms?
questions.notes: OWNER-RUN against the owner's private PDFs. Target + required docs blank for the owner to fill (PDF filenames). Exercises PDF extraction + long-document sectioning; owner confirms breadcrumbs on first run.
